Name: Valentine's Lazy Bees
Author: LashelleValentine
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Bring your apiary to life with [b]Valentine's Lazy Bees![/b]
Have you ever wished your Bee Houses had little bees buzzing around them? Now they can!
Valentine's Lazy Bees is a standalone SMAPI mod that adds adorable animated bees that fly around Bee Houses on your farm. Watch your little pollinators wander around their hives and bring a little extra life to your countryside!
This mod gives your apiary its own little buzzing population.
No Custom Critters required![/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Download and extract Valentine's Lazy Bees.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place the
[/color]
[code]ValentinesLazyBees[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[/color]
[code]Mods[/code][color=#D4D4D8]folder.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Launch Stardew Valley through SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Place Bee Houses on your farm and watch for your new little visitors![/color][/*]
[/list]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Animated Bees:[/b] Little bees fly and wander around Bee Houses.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Seasonal Activity:[/b] Bees can appear during Spring, Summer, and Fall.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Sunny Day Spawning:[/b] By default, bees only appear on sunny days.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Customizable Settings:[/b] Adjust spawn chances, spawn attempts, bee size, and flight speed.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Standalone Mod:[/b] No Custom Critters dependency![/color][/*]
[/list]Valentine's Lazy Bees includes a configurable
[code]config.json[/code]file.
Available settings include:
[list]
[*][code]SpawnChance[/code]: Controls the chance of a bee spawning.[/*]
[*][code]SpawnAttempts[/code]: Controls how many spawn attempts are made.[/*]
[*][code]EnableSpring[/code]: Enables or disables spring activity.[/*]
[*][code]EnableSummer[/code]: Enables or disables summer activity.[/*]
[*][code]EnableFall[/code]: Enables or disables fall activity.[/*]
[*][code]OnlyOnSunnyDays[/code]: Restricts bee spawning to sunny days.[/*]
[*][code]StartTime[/code]: Sets the earliest time bees can appear.[/*]
[*][code]EndTime[/code]: Sets the latest time bees can appear.[/*]
[*][code]BeeScale[/code]: Adjusts the size of the bees.[/*]
[*][code]FlightSpeed[/code]: Adjusts how quickly bees fly.[/*]
[/list]You can customize these settings to suit your farm!

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/color]
